entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Listen up, Inmate! Our master wants[n]a word with you.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: *chuckle* It seems you've formed[n]a contract with another new ally.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: ...This is the owner of quite a different[n]type of power.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: It will help guide you all to further heights[n]as thieves.
What do you want from me?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: *chuckle* Worry not. You are steadily[n]approaching the realization of your goal.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: This is not necessarily to prove so, but[n]I shall increase the number of Personas[n]you can hold at once.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: From here on, your tale will make[n]great progress...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Hone your powers even further, and[n]prepare for the time that will soon come.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: It is time, Inmate. Return to your world.
I feel like my bond with Igor[n]is growing deeper...
entries.uk: Здається, мій зв'язок з Ігорем[n]стає глибшим...
